test_suite_name: V3 Godot Planet Capture Restart Verification
description: Reauthenticate ordinary players after a real serving-server restart and verify captured planet and unrelated assets remain authoritative.

tests.name: Reauthenticate the capturing player after server restart
Reauthenticate the former planet owner after server restart
Authenticated capture owner remains a normal player
Captured planet info matches its persisted owner and slave population
Server restart retained planetary assets and unrelated player/corporation holdings

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id} AND p.population=1000 AND p.population_type='SLAVE' AND p.colonists_unassigned=600 AND p.colonists_ore=100 AND p.colonists_org=100 AND p.colonists_eq=100 AND p.colonists_weapons=100 AND p.fighters=0 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=456 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=54321 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=87654 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='corp' AND owner_id=(SELECT corporation_id FROM corporations WHERE name='Capture Asset QA') AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=7777 AND (SELECT quantity FROM sector_assets WHERE corporation_id=(SELECT corporation_id FROM corporations WHERE name='Capture Asset QA') AND asset_type=1 AND sector_id=(SELECT sector_id+1 FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977790))=17 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977790%')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE p.planet_id=977790;

tests.name: Former owner receives no planet information after capture and restart
